title: Human Response to Window Views and Indoor Plants in the Workplace

stimuli.description: Six simulated office environments: 1) office without a window view and no indoor plants, 2) office without a window view but indoor plants present, 3) office with a window view of a cityscape but no indoor plants present, 4) office with a window view of a cityscape and with indoor plants, 5) office with a window view of nature but no indoor plants present, 6) office with a window view of nature plus the presence of indoor plants.

tables.description: Mean and standard deviation of respondents' response values for EEG-a, EEG-b, EMG, BVP, and State-Anxiety across six individual workplace environment conditions, including F-values and pairwise comparisons.

Mean and standard deviation of respondents' response values for EEG-a, EEG-b, EMG, BVP, and State-Anxiety across three grouped workplace environment conditions (no window, city view, nature view), including F-values and pairwise comparisons.
